title: run_config — session run configuration (produced by Stage 0; decision record 000 §2.1)
description: How this session runs: the resolved app_profile, the verified authentication context, rate-limit settings and the drive mode (V1: manual/replay only).

app_profile.description: The resolved application profile, same shape as the app_profile contract (KD-1 repaid: the loose inline shape tightened to a $ref, approved in decision record 002 §7.3)

auth_context.description: Verified authentication context (Stage 0 acceptance: the authentication probe request returned 200)

rate_limit.description: Rate-limit settings in effect for this session

drive_mode.description: Drive mode: manual = live manual; replay = sequence replay; heuristic = heuristic frontier+reward (reserved); llm_agent = language model/agent (reserved); random = random (degenerate strategy for evaluation, reserved). V1 produces only manual/replay.

trust_basis.description: Write-probe trust basis (decision record 010 D60). Optional; default is equivalent to per_probe_cleanup (keeps V1 run_config fully compatible). environment_reset = environment-level reversibility (resettable instance) as the fallback: write_2xx_no_handle write probes are admitted as trusted, and Stage 2.5 must perform a mandatory reset plus baseline verification at the end of the batch; per_probe_cleanup = per-probe cleanup criterion (the fallback for environments that cannot be reset; behaves as in V1).

rationale.description: Basis for the declared trust basis (e.g. 'the Conduit deployment can be reset as a whole via DROP+CREATE') — persisted as a record; an empty declaration is not allowed.
